name: fbr_zener
rationale: Adds a Zener diode to the reference Full-Bridge Rectifier (FBR) to prevent the output voltage from exceeding 3.6V in S3 (strong excitation, light load). However, it may still fail vout_min in S2 and S4 due to lack of power boosting.

name: sshi_fbr
rationale: Implements Synchronous Switching Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) to increase energy extraction. An L-S-SYNC loop is placed in parallel with the piezo to flip the capacitor voltage at the peaks, effectively boosting the voltage delivered to the FBR. This targets the vout_min and tup failures in S2 and S4.

name: sshi_fbr_zener
rationale: Combines the power boost of SSHI with the overvoltage protection of a Zener clamp. This is intended to satisfy all conditions: vout_min in S2/S4 (via SSHI) and vout_max in S3 (via Zener).
